entries.speaker: Playing Darts
entries.en: Time will pass if you play darts. However, you will[n]have the ability to invite [clr 2]your teammates[clr 27] to play[n]with you. Playing together will help you bond and[n]strengthen the effects of [clr 2]Baton Pass[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Playing Darts
entries.en: Playing darts with your friends may improve[n]your Baton Pass with multiple party members.

entries.speaker: Playing Darts
entries.en: You can view your party members' Baton Pass[n]Rank when choosing who you will invite to[n]play darts. You can also see how your party[n]members play darts by pressing [f 1 10 33].

entries.speaker: Playing Darts
entries.en: You can also play darts by yourself. You won't be[n]able to increase the bonds with your teammates,[n]but you can practice as much as you'd like.
